title: Jailer 2 Crosses Rs 800 Crore, a First for Tamil Cinema
excerpt: Trade trackers put Rajinikanth's sequel at Rs 800-807 crore worldwide after 18 days, with overseas markets supplying about a third of the gross.
body:
• Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 has crossed Rs 800 crore in worldwide gross, becoming the first Tamil film to reach the mark, TrackTollywood reported on Sunday.
  • Trade tracker Sacnilk put the worldwide gross at Rs 807.25 crore after day 18 (Sunday, November 1): Rs 533.75 crore in India and Rs 273.50 crore overseas. All box-office figures are trade estimates, not official studio numbers.
  • The Tamil-language film, directed by Nelson Dilipkumar and released on October 15, had already become the highest-grossing Tamil film in India, passing 2.0's domestic gross.
  • For diaspora audiences, overseas markets supplied roughly a third of the total — North America and the Gulf remain central to a Tamil film's record run.

Tamil cinema has its first Rs 800 crore film. Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 crossed the Rs 800 crore worldwide gross mark with Sunday's collections, TrackTollywood reported, a milestone no Kollywood film had reached before. The tracker put the split at over Rs 525 crore in India and close to Rs 275 crore overseas.

Sacnilk, the other widely cited trade tracker, put the day-18 worldwide gross slightly higher, at Rs 807.25 crore — Rs 533.75 crore gross in India (Rs 456.30 crore net) and Rs 273.50 crore overseas. The film collected a net Rs 11.20 crore in India on day 18 across 8,905 shows, up 15.5% from day 17, Sacnilk reported. Both trackers' figures are estimates compiled from trade reporting; Sun Pictures has not published an official total.

How the run was built

Jailer 2 is a Tamil-language action film directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, reuniting Rajinikanth with the director of 2023's Jailer. Rajinikanth returns as Tiger Muthuvel Pandian, alongside Ramya Krishnan, S. J. Suryah, Vidya Balan, Yogi Babu and Mirnaa, with special appearances reported by Filmverse from Mohanlal, Shiva Rajkumar, Jackie Shroff, Hrithik Roshan and Vijay Sethupathi. It released on October 15.

"Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 crossed the Rs 800 crore worldwide gross mark with Sunday's collections, TrackTollywood reported, a milestone no Kollywood film had reached before."

The records have stacked up in sequence. The film became the highest-grossing Tamil film of all time in 11 days, at Rs 710.35 crore, Filmverse reported. Its India gross passed the roughly Rs 520 crore domestic gross of Rajinikanth's own 2.0, making it the No. 1 Tamil film in India as well as worldwide. It is also the first film to gross more than Rs 75 crore in each of the four major South Indian markets, with Tamil Nadu alone crossing Rs 200 crore gross.

What to watch next

TrackTollywood framed the next target as Rs 850 crore. The more consequential question for the industry is the ceiling this sets: a Tamil film reached Rs 800 crore on the strength of its home market, the other southern states and the overseas diaspora, in the middle of the Diwali holiday window. Whether the run has another record in it depends on how it holds against the new releases arriving this week.
